subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate **ANTONYM** of the underlined word in the following sentence.

The uneducated man was __flummoxed__ by the legal document.
solution:
The correct answer is 'comfortable'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's take a look at the **meaning** of the **given word **and** the marked answer:** 

 
 
• Flummoxed: bewildered or perplexed.

 
 
• Example:* No wonder Josef was feeling a bit flummoxed.*
 
 
 
• Comfortable: giving comfort or physical relief.
 
 
• Example:* He was described as comfortable in the hospital last night.* 
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, from the above-given explanation, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Happy: feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.
 
• Annoyed: slightly angry; irritated.
 
• Scared: fearful; frightened
